key_highlights: RBA issues blunt warning ahead of next rate decision; IMF urges spending cuts as another hike looms, pressuring banks and REITs
ASX closed a volatile week with big four banks advancing on easing oil prices and bond yields, but overall index 'limped across the line'
Iron ore prices under pressure ('roaches seethe'), weighing on BHP, RIO, FMG; LNG export disruption as Japan diverts Australian gas
Recession odds for 2027 rising; housing described as 'absurdly unaffordable'; petrol price shock adds to cost-of-living pressure
Qantas ground staff set to strike over Joyce-era bargaining agreements; Bendigo Bank (BEN.AX) cuts hit Adelaide
Positive exploration: Forrestania WA gold prefeasibility studies; Aurum high-grade gold discovery; ASX small-caps Latrobe, CurveBeam, Arrow, Sultan lead weekly gains
Anthropic secures $31bn datacentre deal in western Queensland, signalling long-term tech infrastructure demand
Middle East oil shock risk elevated; Buffett departs Berkshire at 96, shifting global investor sentiment

sectors.trend: Iron ore weakness and LNG export disruption (Japan diverting Australian gas) pressure BHP, RIO, FMG, WDS, STO. Gold exploration positive with Forrestania and Aurum results.
sectors.implications: Short-term headwind for iron ore names; gold juniors (FOR.AX, AUR.AX) offer relative strength. Diversify away from single-commodity exposure.

sectors.trend: Big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) advanced on easing yields, but RBA hawkish warning and IMF fiscal pressure create overhang. Bendigo Bank (BEN.AX) cutting jobs in Adelaide.
sectors.implications: NIMs may compress if RBA hikes further; credit risk rises with recession odds. Banks offer yield but face policy headwinds.

sectors.trend: Middle East oil shock risk; petrol price shock in Australia; Victoria backs away from renewable transmission; government 'sets course for coal'.
sectors.implications: Short-term oil upside benefits WDS, STO, WES. Renewable policy reversal hurts clean-energy names; coal re-emergence is a structural concern.

sectors.trend: Coles (WES.AX) keeps milk prices elevated despite axing farmer support; Qantas (QAN.AX) strike threat; housing unaffordability suppresses consumer spending.
sectors.implications: Margin pressure on retailers; Qantas strike risk is a near-term catalyst. Defensive staples preferred over discretionary.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre deal signals AI infrastructure buildout; ASX small-caps CurveBeam and Arrow outperform; global AI fears caused US market volatility.
sectors.implications: Long-term structural tailwind for Australian data/infrastructure plays; short-term AI sentiment whipsaw from US markets.

sectors.trend: Housing 'absurdly unaffordable'; tenants catch a break (rental regulation); soaring state interest costs pressure property development.
sectors.implications: REITs face dual pressure: high rates cap valuations, but tenant protections support occupancy. Selective exposure only.

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot and IMF fiscal pressure create a tightening macro backdrop
Commodity stress: iron ore weakness + LNG export disruption hit ASX 200 heavyweight miners
Recession risk for 2027 rising, elevating defensive positioning
Energy transition policy inconsistency (Victoria renewables retreat, coal revival) creates uncertainty
Geopolitical oil shock risk from Middle East/Iran
AI infrastructure investment in Australia (Anthropic QLD) as long-term structural theme
Labour disputes (Qantas, Bendigo) adding operational risk to key ASX names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / hawkish policy surprise
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and high-beta equity exposure; favour fixed-income and dividend-paying banks with strong capital buffers
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (AUR.AX, FOR.AX) and diversified miners

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East oil shock / geopolitical escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy equities (WDS.AX, WES.AX) and gold; monitor Brent crude and AUD/USD
Avoid QAN.AX ahead of strike; monitor airline sector sentiment
Increase cash allocation; favour defensive staples (WES.AX, WOL.AX) and healthcare (CSL.AX)
Underweight property developers and REITs; monitor NAB/CBA credit loss provisions

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold exploration names on positive prefeasibility and discovery news
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania WA and Aurum Côte d'Ivoire results signal sector-wide exploration upside; gold hedges rate and geopolitical risk

opportunities.recommendation: Selective bank exposure for dividend yield, favouring CBA and NAB
opportunities.rationale: Big four advanced on easing yields; CBA and NAB have strongest capital positions to absorb any credit cycle deterioration

opportunities.recommendation: Position for AI infrastructure buildout via QLD datacentre theme
opportunities.rationale: Anthropic $31bn deal signals multi-year capex cycle benefiting Australian infrastructure and tech-adjacent equities

opportunities.recommendation: Energy hedge via Woodside and Woodside-linked LNG plays
opportunities.rationale: Middle East oil shock risk and petrol price spike support upstream energy; LNG export disruption may tighten pricing

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and single-commodity mining exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'roaches seethe' signals sustained price pressure; BHP/RIO/FMG face margin compression

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim REIT and property developer exposure ahead of RBA decision
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing unaffordability, soaring state interest costs, and potential rate hike cap valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid Qantas ahead of potential strike
defensive_moves.rationale: Ground staff strike over Joyce-era agreements creates near-term operational and earnings risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain 10-15% cash allocation as recession odds rise
defensive_moves.rationale: 2027 recession probability increasing; IMF fiscal pressure limits government stimulus response

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain volatile and range-bound. RBA decision is the dominant catalyst; a hawkish surprise would pressure banks, REITs, and growth equities. Iron ore weakness caps materials. Banks may provide relative support. Expect 2-3% index volatility around the RBA meeting.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook is cautiously bearish. Rising 2027 recession odds, IMF fiscal pressure, housing stress, and commodity headwinds argue for a defensive, dividend-focused portfolio. Gold, healthcare (CSL.AX), and energy offer relative resilience. AI infrastructure (Anthropic QLD) is a structural positive but too early for broad market impact.
